messages.author: 8d2cb471019871f2
messages.subject: read.cross loading time
parts:
Hello,
First of all, thanks for the great package! I am trying eQTL which
makes me load lots of phenotype data at once. I first tried read.cross
with 35K phenotype columns (~35Mbyte) but loading took such a long
time so I had to cancel the process. I am in the middle of dividing
them into several files for easier handling (to ~5Mb each). According
to your experience, what is the best way to do this?

My system is new Mac Pro - 8-core 3.2GHz, 32Gb ram.
Thanks,
Murim

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] read.cross loading time
parts:
I've not had much experience with this yet, and so I can't say what's
going on.
In what format are you trying to read it?

The slowness might be related to the checks I do to decide whether
phenotypes are numeric or not.

I'd suggest reading in the phenotype data separately from the genotype
data, and then pasting it into the cross object afterwards.

karl
